legacyEvidence.meaning: The 50 raw-source gaps are all retired; all 67 retired binary exclusions also have zero serialized non-meta Assets references. No old HEAD blob extraction is necessary for current runtime.

ui-assets.method: Current game art/scene catalogs and sampled audio. Pillow decodes images, ffmpeg libvorbis q6 restores current Opus music; source/output receipts are regenerated. Includes battle/fx-atlas.webp at its dedicated BattleFxAtlas path. Also restores settlement failure art at its dedicated Current/Settlement path; no legacy deploy script is required.

ui-fonts.method: Eight WOFF2 faces decoded to TTF with glyph/metric checks; HarmonyOS Regular/Bold copied byte for byte plus three current licenses.

node-rooms.method: Current node-room lossless source images and source-derived icons; explicit --output writes formal Resources, while omission retains the historical draft/Resources default. Requires sibling source-data.json and eight source-svg files.
dependencies: CairoSVG with native Cairo shared library

archive.method: Current slot and achievement source images/inline SVG.

home.method: Current source home images, final CSS-derived visuals and WOFF2 fonts.

photo.method: Current photo source image and SVG conversion.

shop.method: Two current source shop images; preserve tracked CurrentGuide PNG meta template used by this helper.

retired-no-restore.method: Legacy resource family has no current literal loader consumers and no serialized GUID references in Assets non-meta text. Exclude retired binary and omit its corresponding meta from the new validated branch export only. Current worktree and local Unity legacy files remain unchanged; do not restore old fallback assets.

restoreBoundary: Retain exported active resource .meta import settings. Omit exactly omittedLegacyMeta from the new branch export only; do not delete current worktree legacy files, regenerate active import settings, or introduce old fallback assets.

Full restoration commands were not executed. Only two dedicated image targets were converted inside a verified temporary directory; existing Assets and receipts were unchanged. Existing fonts and fonts-receipt.json stayed unchanged during --check-sources.

Source SHA and parent HEAD availability were verified. Rebuilt PNG/Vorbis/WOFF2-TTF byte identity across tool versions/timestamps is not claimed; existing import routines retain pixel/glyph/metric checks.
Importers also read committed game source catalogs/CSS/data; preserve the parent game layout and completed source baseline.
